subcategory_gloss: pharmaceutical distribution and cold-chain quality disposition
domain_rationale: Correctness is decided by a distributor's cold-chain quality procedure: how temperature-logger records of each distribution leg are attributed to time, charged against a product's stability excursion allowances carried across the whole distribution chain (including time the release certificate already consumed), how mean kinetic temperature summarises the chain, and how a lot is released, quarantined or rejected. The deliverable is the QA disposition of product lots moving through the supply chain. Closest competing pair rejected: Operations / Compliance (the SOP is an internal GDP quality procedure, but the judgement is about product condition across a multi-leg distribution chain rather than regulatory reporting); Operations / Logistics (routing and carriage are given, not decided); Science / Chemistry (Arrhenius kinetics enters only as the fixed MKT formula the SOP states).
evidence: instruction.md: symptoms are distribution-chain outcomes (lots released after two warm legs, a lot held on its labelled limit booked as an excursion, MKT not matching QA's figure, logger dropouts missing from unlogged time)
environment/app/docs/qa-sop-lot-disposition.md: a numbered QA procedure for disposing product lots from shipment-leg logger exports and the product stability record

planned verifier (step 4 onward): whole-report comparison of per-lot disposition, band hours, remaining allowances, unlogged hours and MKT against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, which is derived from the SOP
